title: Time policy replacement leaves now-disallowed current source valid
description: Post-fix correctness review: StratumTracker.replace_policy only runs age expiry. Removing the active source/peer or tightening accuracy leaves wall_clock_valid true. Atomically re-evaluate current sample/evidence under the new immutable policy, invalidate if disallowed while preserving anchor/reference/replay state, and test source, peer, and accuracy revocation.
notes: Security rereview extension: replacement revalidation remains incomplete for Internal RTC. Tightening max_sample_age_s below immutable evidence.rtc_age_seconds leaves active RTC valid because _expire_locked checks only observation age and _replacement_policy_rejection checks only class/accuracy/network peer. Re-run every policy-controlled/source-specific predicate affected by replacement; add active RTC age threshold tightening tests while preserving anchor/reference/replay semantics.
